businessProblem: Supertech Ltd. requires immediate diagnosis of root causes and a highest-priority action plan given a Rs 432+ crore lender default, pending insolvency petition, significant homebuyer delivery failures across multiple projects, and cash-flow mismatch creating an acute insolvency risk as of 24 March 2022.

evidence.finding: Default of more than Rs 432 crore to Union Bank of India linked to Eco Village II project; insolvency petition pending before NCLT
evidence.source: Union Bank of India petition and lender records

evidence.finding: Cash-flow mismatch between project collections and delivery/debt obligations; insufficient liquidity to service debt and complete projects simultaneously
Significant homebuyer delivery delays and project-completion failures across multiple residential projects; construction progress stalled
evidence.source: Homebuyer complaints and project status reporting

evidence.finding: Homebuyer trust collapsed due to repeated non-delivery; large pipeline of committed but incomplete projects
evidence.source: Homebuyer confidence signals and project pipeline data

evidence.finding: Inadequate project-level fund ring-fencing; management credibility impaired by delivery failures and growing legal actions
evidence.source: Governance review and sector regulatory norms

evidence.finding: Multiple lender exposure with no coordinated resolution; no concluded standstill or restructuring arrangement
evidence.source: Lender exposure and creditor coordination analysis

clientContext.size: Major residential developer with large multi-city project portfolio
clientContext.revenueImpactUrgency: Critical - pending insolvency petition, homebuyer delivery failure, lender default
